datasets.name: UCI Air Quality
quality_notes: Missing values use -200 and must become null.
CO reference is mg/m3 and is not silently relabelled as ppm.
The nominal O3-targeted metal-oxide response is not O3 ground truth.
The dataset includes cross-sensitivity and sensor drift and is suitable for regression/drift experiments, not chip-identical deployment claims.

datasets.name: Multi-sensor, Multi-device Smart Building Indoor Environmental Dataset
datasets.license: Non-Commercial Government Licence for public sector information
quality_notes: The source sensor is BME680, not chip-identical to BME688.
The source Gas value is an IAQ index, not gas resistance in ohms and not calibrated MH-Z19 CO2.
Use leave-device-out evaluation across the eight endpoints when possible.
The complete archive is intentionally not auto-downloaded.

datasets.name: Gary Stafford IoT telemetry
quality_notes: Regression and pipeline compatibility only.
Derived pressure or calibrated gas values are synthetic and must never be mixed with real field evaluation.

datasets.name: Project real sensor capture
canonical_coverage: all fields actually produced by verified RAB sensors
quality_notes: This is the only lane that can validate deployed sensor calibration and field performance.
Store raw envelopes append-only and derive canonical data through the official adapter.

datasets.name: Fidas 200S reference PM at two-minute resolution
quality_notes: The selected file contains reference-grade Fidas 200S values, not PMS7003T output.
The adapter keeps PM values under reference.* and leaves project sensor PM fields null.
Use paired low-cost records and time/site-aware splits for calibration evaluation.
Do not claim chip-identical or deployed-node performance from this dataset alone.

datasets.name: SensEURCity multi-city low-cost air-quality dataset
datasets.expected_size_note: about 5.7 GB archive; schema sampling and storage approval required
quality_notes: Relevant for multi-city and leave-site-out research, but too large for automatic project download.
An adapter is intentionally not promoted until the archive schema is sampled and provenance per city/device is confirmed.
Low-cost systems are not chip-identical to the project RAB sensors.
Missing project fields must remain null; no cross-dataset fabrication is allowed.

datasets.name: Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality
datasets.expected_size_note: 8,192,212-byte ZIP verified 2026-07-31; UCI interface labels the main archive 7.6 MB
quality_notes: Hourly reference monitoring and meteorological data from 12 Beijing sites, not low-cost project sensor output.
Missing values are denoted NA and must remain missing unless a separately labelled sensitivity analysis is run.
Keep station identity and evaluate every station passing a preregistered coverage gate.
Do not merge stations into one fabricated device timeline.

datasets.name: Intel Berkeley Research Lab Sensor Data
datasets.license: Permission granted for use or reproduction with acknowledgement; source provides no warranty
datasets.expected_size_note: 34,422,518-byte gzip verified 2026-07-31; official page states about 150 MB uncompressed
quality_notes: Approximately 2.3 million readings from 54 Mica2Dot nodes collected in a research lab in 2004.
Some mote streams are missing or truncated; inclusion must use a coverage rule fixed before model evaluation.
Voltage is strongly temperature-correlated and is not evidence of project battery health.
Any five-minute aggregation must be labelled deterministic resampling; raw readings remain immutable.

datasets.name: External battery/power proxy dataset
quality_notes: No public battery-aging dataset is promoted as a direct INA226/node battery model yet.
Different chemistry, load profile, regulator, and sampling make such data proxy-only.
The production node-health rule remains telemetry/rules-first until project battery traces exist.
